correctness.rationale: In characteristic other than 3 the Fermat surface is smooth, and the 27 pairing/phase equations give distinct lines on it, hence all its lines by the classical smooth cubic count. Same-family meeting requires one common exponent; cross-family elimination reduces to one congruence modulo three, for example a+d=b+c between (01|23) and (02|13). Cross-family determinants that do not vanish are units times differences of third roots and have norm 3; skew same-family determinants have two such factors and norm 9. This proves reduction preserves the incidence graph even in characteristic two. Independently regenerated the graph by modular exponent congruences, found all sixers by clique recursion, and checked every pair of sixers against the double-six incidence (five neighbors on both sides). It yields the determinant norm census 135/162/54, 72 sixers, unique partners giving 36 double-sixes, and the exact two fixed sextuples printed in the source. The involution on unordered double-sixes has four fixed objects, one with both halves fixed and three swapped. All three fixed lines have zero exponents, absent from the fixed sixers, whose six elements therefore form three pairs each. Replay `python3 /workspace/branches/independent_reproduce.py` (section 2). The finite étale zeta factors follow from cycles of sizes 1 and 2. A Frobenius-stable sixer contracts uniquely up to target isomorphism and descends; the degree-nine target is Severi–Brauer and splits over a finite field. Conversely a blow-down to P² has exactly this exceptional sixer.
residual_risks: The zeta functions are for the finite marking schemes, not the surface. Frobenius-stable markings need not comprise individually rational lines.

value.rationale: For a classical finite-field surface the calculation settles an exact natural descent invariant, including the distinction between a rational unordered marking and a marking rational half by half. It determines the fields of definition of all markings via the orbit spectra and counts distinct contraction morphisms. Although finite, the census is complete for this surface in every allowed characteristic and is useful independently of a broader Weyl-group count.
residual_risks: The assessment concerns the nonsplit arithmetic refinement; the split counts and zeta conversion alone would not be substantial new results.
